text: In this month nineteen of us reached for "innovation and opportunity act," and eighteen for "the workforce innovation and opportunity act," peaking together on 2022-05-17. Then eighteen of us said "fuel price gouging prevention act," and seventeen "consumer fuel price gouging prevention act," seventeen more "the consumer fuel price gouging prevention," cresting on 2022-05-19; Kim Schrier said it first. Seventeen of us said "health protection act." And on 2022-05-03 sixteen of us said "the supreme court," fifteen "draft supreme court," which Pete Aguilar said first that same day. We record that in one week we converged twice — on a fuel measure and on a leaked draft — and that our workforce language, first spoken years earlier, returned in unison. We note the counts. We said these words together, and we said them close.
